quotes.text: Ask the customer to attempt the payment again. If it still can’t be processed, the customer needs to contact their card issuer.
The user canceled their Klarna checkout session.
The BLIK code is invalid or malformed.
BLIK codes expire after 2 minutes, please request another code from the customer.
The specific reason for the decline shouldn’t be reported to the customer. Instead, present it as `partner_generic_decline`.

old_evidence.text: The payment needs to be attempted again. If it still can’t be processed, try again later.
The following Stripe decline codes can be used for Local Payment Method (LPM) payments:
The payment provider has declined the payment.

findings: Same canonical URL and same card/LPM decline-code reference, with Stripe decline codes distinct from issuer codes and optional advice_code guidance (old lines 4-16; new lines 5-17). The 50 card table rows remain 50. Most card changes are wording or formatting, but processing_error next-step guidance changes materially: old line 56 says retry then try again later, while new line 57 says retry then contact the issuer if still unprocessed.

The LPM table grows from 19 rows with 19 distinct decline codes (old lines 77-95) to 29 rows with 27 distinct decline codes (new lines 78-106). Three Klarna outcome rows share one decline code, klarna_payment_declined (new lines 78-80), so the source should not describe 29 distinct codes. Eight distinct decline-code names are added: klarna_payment_declined, customer_declined, code_invalid, code_expired, partner_action_not_supported, lost_or_stolen_card, card_already_activated, invalid_track_data. No old LPM code is removed.

Klarna additions distinguish a declined payment, user-canceled checkout, and expired checkout through charge outcome reason while sharing klarna_payment_declined (new lines 78-80). BLIK code_invalid and code_expired map to generic_decline outcome, and code_expired's API message says BLIK codes expire after two minutes and asks for another code (new lines 83-84). Do not collapse decline code, charge outcome reason, seller message, and API error message into one field.

Additional LPM rows carry consequential actions: partner_action_not_supported and card_already_activated say retries will not succeed (new lines 103, 105); lost_or_stolen_card says hide the specific reason from customers and present partner_generic_decline (new line 104); invalid_track_data directs checking with the issuer (new line 106). Keep these actions scoped to the particular table rows and payment methods.

Current source lines 13, 51-75 claim 19 LPM codes and list only the old rows; update that coverage and preserve the May count as dated. Concept wiki/concepts/stripe-declines.md line 150 also says 19 total and 'not on cards'; the latter is overbroad because expired_card, processing_error, insufficient_funds, currency_not_supported, invalid_amount, and duplicate_transaction occur in both card and LPM tables (old lines 30, 38, 40, 56, 26, 29, 81-85, 94; new lines 27, 31, 39, 41, 57, 88-92, 101).

Current source line 45 narrows testmode_decline to a test card used in live mode, while both raws only say a Stripe test card number was used and a genuine card must be used (old line 65; new line 66). Current source line 48 says deprecated do_not_try_again and try_again_later are now advice_code values; both raws mark them deprecated in the decline-code table, but do not establish the asserted migration of those exact values to advice_code (old lines 28, 67; new lines 29, 68). Avoid the unsupported expansions when updating.
substantive_changes: LPM table expands from 19 to 29 rows and from 19 to 27 distinct decline-code names; eight new distinct names are listed in findings (old lines 77-95; new lines 78-106).
Three Klarna rows share klarna_payment_declined but differentiate declined, canceled, and expired checkout outcome reasons (new lines 78-80).
BLIK code_invalid/code_expired rows and their generic_decline outcome mapping, including the two-minute code-expiry message, are new (new lines 83-84).

New LPM lost_or_stolen_card instruction masks the specific reason with partner_generic_decline; partner_action_not_supported and card_already_activated say retries will not succeed (new lines 103-105).
Card processing_error second step changes from try again later to contact issuer if retry remains unsuccessful (old line 56; new line 57).
historical_claims_to_preserve: Keep the May capture's 19-row/19-distinct-name LPM table as dated history, and the November table's 29 rows/27 names as the newer captured reference (old lines 75-95; new lines 76-106).

Retain the 50 card rows, masking of fraudulent/lost_card/stolen_card/merchant_blacklist as generic_decline, and deprecated labels for do_not_try_again and try_again_later (old lines 18-69; new lines 19-70).

Retain card authentication_required's usually automatic Stripe-front-end soft-decline auth flow with off-session qualification, and authentication_not_handled's need for 3DS/SCA with on-session preparation (old lines 20-21; new lines 21-22).

Retain separate LPM columns for decline code, charge outcome reason, seller message, and API error message; shared code names across card/LPM rows do not imply identical next-step semantics (old lines 75-95; new lines 76-106).
conflicts: May old card processing_error next step says try again later after a failed retry; November new line 57 directs contacting the issuer if still unprocessed. Cite the capture date when giving next-step guidance.

Existing source and concept say 19 LPM codes, whereas November has 29 rows and 27 distinct decline-code names. The term 'codes' should not be equated with rows because Klarna has three outcome rows under one code.
Existing concept says LPM-specific codes are 'not on cards', although several code names appear in both card and LPM tables; new lines 27, 31, 39, 41, 57, 88-92, 101 show examples.
Existing source's live-mode interpretation of testmode_decline and claim that the two deprecated decline-code names are now advice_code values exceed both captures' wording.
unresolved_questions: The reference table does not prove which of the listed LPM codes is emitted by a specific payment provider or account; table presence is not a guarantee of runtime occurrence.
The captures label do_not_try_again and try_again_later deprecated but do not specify from this page alone whether their exact names now appear as advice_code values.
The captures do not establish that testmode_decline necessarily means a test card was used in live mode.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/declines/codes, [[source-stripe-decline-codes]] changes substantially in the local-payment-method table. Old lines 75-95 contain 19 rows and 19 distinct decline names; new lines 76-106 contain 29 rows and 27 distinct names, including Klarna, BLIK, and partner additions. Klarna uses one decline code across three outcome reasons (new lines 78-80), so rows must not be counted as unique codes. Card processing_error guidance also changes from try again later at old line 56 to contact the issuer after an unsuccessful retry at new line 57.
answers.Q2: Recommend source_required_update for [[source-stripe-decline-codes]] at https://docs.stripe.com/declines/codes. Update the source and stripe-declines concept's dated 19-LPM count to describe 29 November rows and 27 distinct names (old lines 77-95; new lines 78-106). Highlight Klarna's three outcome reasons, BLIK code expiry and generic outcome mapping (new lines 78-84), and lost_or_stolen_card customer masking as partner_generic_decline (new line 104). Correct card processing_error next steps using old line 56 and new line 57. Keep decline code separate from charge outcome reason and avoid assuming these table entries were observed in live payments.
